en: Sepia-toned photograph showing a crowd gathered around an early experimental flying machine or airship gondola mounted on a wagon with large wooden wheels, in a field. Several men in early 20th‑century clothing are working on or inspecting the machine, which features a large propeller at the rear. In the lower left corner appears a handwritten studio mark reading "Atelier Pünat" (or similar). The image has the proportions and border style of an old photographic postcard.
